state_breaks.detail: Agent Brown is left 'still outside the hotel' at the end of ev-001 (safety register), but ev-002's summary has him already committing to the front-door route while Smith breaks off — the step inside that the split requires is not recorded as having happened, so he reads as still-outside then already-split with no movement between.

contradictions.detail: ev-001 fixes Brown and Jones as a pair advancing with Smith ('stepping out with Brown and Jones'), and ev-002 shows the two of them splitting — but Jones is dropped entirely from ev-002 with no account of where he goes, so the 'two agents who arrived together split' framing contradicts the three-agent arrival the earlier event established.

missing_links.detail: ev-001's affects_outside states the Agents' takeover of the operation is their opening; ev-002 realises exactly that takeover by having Smith direct the split and assign Brown the front entrance, yet neither node marks this as the handoff — the command Smith was 'still taking' in ev-001 is shown already exercised in ev-002 without the event boundary naming it.

state_breaks.detail: Agent Brown's positional register ends ev-002 'Alone, moving down the alley beside the hotel, separated from Brown' — wait, that is Smith's exit. Brown's ev-002 exit is 'ready to move into the hotel' (front doors), yet ev-003 has Brown entering the hall and pursuing Trinity over the rooftops. The front-entrance assignment is never reconciled with his appearance deep in the chase; nothing in ev-003 accounts for how the man posted at the front doors is now the one over the parapet.

Agent Smith ends ev-002 'Unthreatened, because he never enters the room while the police still hold' and is boxed as moved:false physical 'Alone in the alley beside the hotel.' Yet ev-003 has him driving a garbage truck onto the street and smashing the phone booth. The event declares his body untouched 'until he reappears driving the truck,' but offers no register change or mechanism for the alley-loiterer becoming the truck driver — a positional move is recorded, but the physical/safety continuity of that sudden vehicle is unaccounted.

contradictions.detail: ev-002 affects_outside states the front and alley are both covered so 'a clean escape from the hotel is no longer available,' and Brown is posted at the front doors. ev-003 then has Trinity escaping cleanly and Brown abandoning his post to chase her over the rooftops. The earlier event's sealed-net outcome is directly undone, and neither node narrates the net opening again — the later event simply realises an escape the earlier event said was impossible, without acknowledging the reversal.

ev-003 records Agent Brown's status exit as 'Revealed as an unnatural, superhuman threat equal to Trinity' via duplicating the leap, but his emotional register is marked moved:false ('the physical chase is beneath him') while his safety register claims he was 'never at risk' and 'matching Trinity at every turn.' A being for whom the chase is beneath him and who is never at risk is not coherently 'matching' a fleeing, bleeding, broken target — the superhuman reveal and the untroubled-unchanged framing assert incompatible stakes for the same pursuit.

missing_links.detail: ev-002 affects_outside 'enables' a box-in from front and alley and 'blocks_or_costs' the removal of any unguarded exit; ev-003 plainly realises exactly this pressure — 'each exit being closed or guarded in turn: the hall by Agent Brown, the alley below by Agent Smith' — forcing Trinity onto the rooftops. Neither event states that the earlier event's coordinated coverage is what drove her up and over, though ev-003's 'off_screen_reactor' and affects describe the outcome without crediting the mechanism ev-002 set up.

state_breaks.detail: Trinity's physical register enters ev-004 at 'On her feet and moving again despite the pain, answering the phone a split-second before the truck destroys the booth' — a body in the middle of a violent escape, injured and moving on adrenaline — and exits into 'Standing close to Neo in a smoke-filled, music-thumping room, pressing her body against his and leaning to whisper directly into his ear.' Nothing in either event accounts for how she went from bleeding and broken at a phone booth to composed and physically intimate at a party: the exit run, the trip up the line, any recovery of her injuries, and her transit to the gathering are all absent, so she arrives already whole and unhurried.

Trinity's safety register enters ev-004 at 'Connected to a compromised hardline, told she must reach a different phone to escape' — mid-flight, actively being hunted — and exits at 'Having completed that escape, she moves freely enough to approach Neo face to face, though she still warns that she does not have much time.' The change field asserts the escape was completed and she now moves freely, but neither event narrates the completion of that escape or the transition from hunted fugitive to someone able to linger at a social gathering; the danger is simply gone at the join.

missing_links.detail: ev-003's affects_outside states the Agents now hold 'Neo' as a named target with 'a machine search already running,' and ev-004's off_screen_reactor confirms 'The Agents, who already have his name, now have a target whose movements have begun.' Yet neither event's narrative registers actually carry the effect that connects them: ev-003 never records that the search is directed at locating Neo in the Matrix (only that they have his name), and ev-004 never records that the intrusion of Neo's PC, the summons, or the surveillance he is warned about is the search acting on that name. The effect ev-003 claims to send into the world — the hunt turning toward Neo — is realised in ev-004's events but is left as an off-screen inference rather than stated in either node.

state_breaks.detail: Neo's safety register enters ev-005 as 'Explicitly warned that he is in danger and being watched, reframing his solitude as surveillance,' but his emotional and status registers show him detached, inwardly elsewhere, and merely compliant. Nothing in ev-005 accounts for how the acute alarm of being watched (ev-004 exit) coexists with this detached, routine-compliant state — the danger-awareness is asserted to persist yet has no observable effect on his behaviour or the scene.

Neo's safety register is marked moved:false across the join (ev-004 exit -> ev-005 exit both 'warned and being watched'), yet ev-005's affects_outside and status/emotional registers show the ordinary world actively reasserting its claim and smothering his momentum. The event's own logic is that his relationship to the danger has been suppressed/smothered, which is a change the safety register refuses to record.

contradictions.detail: ev-005 summary and affects_outside state that the pull toward the unknown is 'temporarily smothered' and that the event 'costs Neo the momentum of his commitment,' but Neo's knowledge register is marked moved:false with identical entry/exit, and his safety register is also moved:false. The event narrates a suppression of his trajectory while simultaneously asserting the registers tracking that trajectory (knowledge, safety) did not move — the smothering is claimed as an event-level effect but denied at the register level.

ev-005 emotional register exit says Neo is 'Detached and inwardly elsewhere, outwardly compliant,' and the summary says the pull is 'temporarily smothered,' yet the safety register insists he remains fully 'warned that he is in danger and being watched' with no change. A man who is inwardly elsewhere and having his obsession smothered is not cleanly identical to a man actively holding onto the surveillance warning; the two registers describe incompatible inner states at the same exit point.

missing_links.detail: ev-004 affects_outside.enables claims the event 'confirms to the unseen watchers that he [is a target]' and that 'the Agents, who already have his name, now have a target whose movements have begun.' ev-005 realises exactly this: Neo is at Meta CorTechs under Rhineheart's discipline, and affects_outside notes 'the Agents, watching him' and that their surveillance is what will convert this friction into a physical threat. Neither node states that ev-004's 'unseen watchers now have a moving target' is what places Neo under observation at Meta CorTechs in ev-005 — the watcher-thread is carried in affects_outside on both sides but never linked as the connective tissue between the two events.

state_breaks.detail: Neo's 'knowledge' register is fine, but his 'emotional' register exit in ev-005 ('Detached and inwardly elsewhere, outwardly compliant to Rhineheart's authority') connects cleanly to ev-006's entry. However, Neo's 'safety' register shows a break: ev-005 explicitly records his safety as unchanged (still merely warned/watched, ordinary-world friction), while ev-006 opens with him already 'exposed at his desk' and immediately in an active raid. The transition from 'routine workplace reprimand, no confirmed danger' to 'a search is already sweeping the floor' is not bridged — the Agents' arrival that converts the friction into physical threat happens between the events and is recorded by neither at its onset.

missing_links.detail: ev-005's affects_outside explicitly claims this event 're-establishes Neo inside the ordinary world's hierarchy so that the reprimand can serve as the prelude to the Agents' arrival, his interrogation, and his physical modification,' and its off_screen_reactor states the Agents' surveillance 'is what will convert this petty workplace friction into a physical threat.' ev-006 plainly realises exactly this — the Agents arrive and seize him, converting the friction into physical seizure. Neither event's state layer narrates the Agents' arrival as the turning mechanism; the outward effect ev-005 advertises is fulfilled in ev-006 but is not carried across the join as a recorded change, it simply appears already in progress (Agent Smith already 'leading the search, entering Neo's row'). The handoff of the promised escalation is left off-screen between the two nodes.

state_breaks.detail: Neo's physical state is continuous across the join. ev-006 exits him handcuffed and forced into a dark sedan at the SKYSCRAPER; ev-007 opens with him carried from that same sedan into the INTERROGATION ROOM and seated restrained at the table. The entry of the later event is accounted for by the earlier event's exit, so there is no break.

contradictions.detail: No contradiction. Neo's positional register in ev-007 opens by restating ev-006's exit (handcuffed, dark sedan, SKYSCRAPER) before moving him into the INTERROGATION ROOM, so the two events assert the same facts at the seam. Agent Smith's registers also carry over identically (cold/unhurried, in control, certain the prey is cornered, lead hunter), confirming continuity rather than conflict.

missing_links.detail: ev-006's affects_outside explicitly states that Neo's capture delivers him into the Agents' hands for 'whatever they intend to do to him' and that Morpheus cannot predict it. ev-007 realises exactly this outward effect: the Agents hold Neo in the INTERROGATION ROOM and Smith moves to turn him against Morpheus. Neither node's state registers narrate this hand-off, but it is not a defect — the earlier event flags the outcome as an open intention ('something Morpheus admits he cannot predict') rather than a specific realised effect, and the later event simply fulfils that intention. No specific effect is claimed-and-realised without acknowledgment, so this is not a missing link.

state_breaks.detail: Neo's body leaves ev-007 with a wire-creature burrowed into his navel and his lips fused, and enters ev-008 'body intact and normal,' his mouth and stomach fine. The later event's physical register offers no account of the implant's removal or his mouth's restoration, so the two physical states abut with nothing bridging them.

missing_links.detail: ev-007's affects_outside claims the implant gives the Agents 'a way to track or control him,' and ev-008's affects_outside realises exactly that by having the group 'extract the tracking bug' from Neo. Neither event states that the implant is what enables Neo to be located/collected, so the tracking function ev-007 advertises is fulfilled in ev-008 without either node saying so.

state_breaks.detail: The car's `safety` register exits ev-009 as 'Gone, disappeared into the rainy night, having reached the deserted alley,' but the car's `positional` register and the event summary place it stopped and parked in that alley. The car is a fixed, present location for the next scene, not a vanished object; its `safety` exit contradicts its own `positional` exit and the rest of ev-009.

The earlier event ends with the car stopped in a deserted alley behind Hotel Lafayette and the crew having arrived. The later event's Trinity 'physical' register is flagged moved:false with entry 'Seated in the car, door open, waiting on the bridge' and exit identical, the unchanged_because claiming these scenes 'never return her to the car.' But the later event's own Trinity 'positional' register has her entering 'Inside the moving car with Neo, carrying him away' and then delivering him to Morpheus's door. Trinity cannot both be waiting on a bridge in a stationary car at the later event's entry and be inside a moving car carrying Neo away as that same event's first change. The two Trinity registers within the later event contradict each other, and the 'physical' register's frozen bridge state is inconsistent with the arrival-and-handoff the event narrates.

The later event's Trinity 'positional' entry ('Inside the moving car with Neo, carrying him away') is a verbatim carryover of the earlier event's Trinity positional exit, and its 'knowledge'/'emotional'/'status'/'safety' entries are verbatim carryovers of the earlier event's exits — yet the event's actual first action is Trinity delivering Neo to Morpheus and withdrawing to the equipment room. The positional register then records that delivery as a change. So the entry states a state (still in the moving car, carrying Neo) that the event immediately overwrites, with the entry functioning as an unstated prior state rather than the true entry condition. The earlier event's affects_outside already noted the car 'reached the deserted alley' and stopped, so a 'moving car, carrying him away' entry at the next event is a state that the earlier event itself had already ended.

contradictions.detail: The earlier event ends with the car having 'come to a stop' in 'a deserted alley behind [...]' and the crew having arrived at Hotel Lafayette. The later event's Trinity 'physical' register freezes her at entry as 'Seated in the car, door open, waiting on the bridge' — a bridge location that contradicts the alley where the earlier event left the car, and a 'waiting' posture that contradicts the later event's own narration of her actively delivering Neo to Morpheus's door. The two events place Trinity in different locations (alley vs. bridge) at the join with nothing accounting for the relocation, and the later event internally contradicts its own 'waiting on the bridge' by immediately having her deliver Neo indoors.

Within the later event, Trinity's 'physical' register says she never returns to the car and stays in the hotel rooms (moved:false, exit 'Seated in the car, door open, waiting on the bridge'), while her 'positional' register says she is 'Inside the moving car with Neo, carrying him away' at entry and then delivers him to Morpheus's door. The same entity at the same moment is both frozen in a parked car on a bridge and moving through the streets carrying Neo — incompatible states asserted by the two registers of one event.

missing_links.detail: The earlier event's affects_outside states that with the tracker gone 'the crew has erased the wire tap on Neo and can move him without the machines following.' The later event realises exactly this condition — Neo is delivered to Morpheus and put through the extraction to be located and unplugged, an operation premised on the machines having lost the signal — but neither the earlier event's Neo/tracker registers nor the later event's entry registers state that the removal of the bug is what permits the crew to proceed to the hotel and run the extraction. The enabling effect is claimed in affects_outside and plainly realised downstream, yet no state register at the join carries it.

The earlier event ends with the crew having captured the writhing bug in a glass cage and dumped it, and the car stopping behind Hotel Lafayette. The later event proceeds directly to the extraction that the captured tracker made necessary, but no register in either event links the captured/removed tracker (earlier exit) to the decision to run the red-pill extraction (later event). The captured bug is the reason the crew can now safely unplug Neo, but that causal bridge is left to affects_outside rather than being stated as a state at the join.

state_breaks.detail: Neo's safety register enters ev-011 as 'In medical crisis, the operation racing against his failing body as he is pulled into darkness' (a monitored patient), and its change explicitly says he is 'no longer a monitored patient.' But ev-010's affects_outside already delivered him into the completed extraction with his location locked and the signal being called, so the event that ends his monitored state is recorded in ev-010, not ev-011. The entry state he carries into ev-011 is therefore a state ev-010 has already moved past, and nothing in ev-011 re-establishes the monitoring that his entry presupposes.

Morpheus's physical and positional registers enter ev-011 with an entry of 'Standing at the car, having directed the bug removal' / 'In the other room, directing the crew and timing the signal,' yet their change sentences relocate him 'from the car to the hovercraft's equipment room to run the extraction, then to Neo's side on the deck.' The extraction he is said to run happens inside ev-010, so ev-011's change narrates a movement that belongs to the earlier event rather than to the pod-birth of ev-011.

contradictions.detail: ev-010's affects_outside states the completed lock 'delivers him into Morpheus's hands for the awakening that follows' and that the crew 'now has his real-world location and the means to reach him,' treating the delivery as accomplished by the end of ev-010. ev-011's affects_outside then states that 'Neo's delivery aboard the hovercraft puts Morpheus face to face with the man he has been preparing to meet,' treating that same delivery as the achievement of ev-011. The two events each claim to be the one that completes Neo's handover to Morpheus.

missing_links.detail: ev-010's affects_outside claims the outward effect that the crew 'now has his real-world location and the means to reach him' and that Tank is 'called for the signal' to complete the extraction. ev-011 plainly realises this by showing Neo disconnected, vacuumed out, and hauled aboard the hovercraft — the extraction the signal was meant to finish. Neither node ties ev-010's claimed 'means to reach him / signal sent' to ev-011's real-world recovery as a single continuous operation, so the bridge between the called signal and the completed retrieval is left unstated.

state_breaks.detail: Neo's positional register enters ev-012 'helped up to stand facing Morpheus' (upright on the hovercraft floor), but its change opens by having him lie on the infirmary table under repair. Nothing in either node accounts for the move from standing to supine between the two events.
